# Set up
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../00_dirs.R")
source("../fun_mod/fun_ampphi.R")
source("../fun_mod/fun_checkgaps.R")
```

# Read in the data  
```{r}
dat_l <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE), readRDS)
names(dat_l) <- sub(".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1|v3)_s08.*", "\\1", 
                    str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE))

waic_df <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waic.rds")) %>% 
  filter(dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08", "seallsero_s08", "se2_s08", "semeth2_s08"))
```

# Read in data and assess gaps and missing data ====================================================
```{r}
all_datagaps <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagaps.rds"), dir = "", {
  # Define models converging that have a sine function
  df_converged <- filter(waic_df, dat %in% c("s08", "semeth_s08", "seallsero_s08", "se2_s08", "semeth2_s08"),
                       mod_out == "imm", str_detect(mod_name, "cs"))
  # Per model
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    # Select the model
    dat_mod <- filter(df_converged, mod == x)
    sens <- case_when(dat_mod$dat == "semeth_s08" ~ "semeth",
                      dat_mod$dat == "semeth2_s08" ~ "semeth2",
                      dat_mod$dat == "se2_s08" ~ "se2",
                      dat_mod$dat == "seallsero_s08" ~ "seallsero",
                      .default = "")
    # Read in data
    dat_raw <- readRDS(paste0(dirs$modfit, "/data", sens, "_brms_", dat_mod$pat[[1]], "_v",
                              dat_mod$vac[[1]], "_s08.rds"))
    # Create clu in the data
    if(!str_detect(x, "csi")) {
      dat_raw <- mutate(dat_raw, clu = NA)
      } else {
      dat_raw <- rename(dat_raw, clu = all_of(filter(df_converged, mod == x)$reg[[1]])) %>%
        mutate(clu = as.character(clu))
      }
    # Identify gaps and missing data
    dat_gap <- expand.grid(vac_week_v1 = 1:52,
                           clu = unique(dat_raw$clu),
                           imm_name = str_remove_all(str_subset(names(dat_raw), "imm_val_s1"),
                                                     "imm_val_s1|_anti_|_")) %>%
      # Create df of total values per week
      left_join(dat_raw %>%
                  group_by(vac_week_v1, clu) %>%
                  summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
                  group_by(clu) %>%
                  mutate(checkgaps = fun_checkgaps(vac_week_v1)) %>%
                  ungroup(),
                by = join_by(vac_week_v1, clu)) %>%
      select(clu, everything()) %>%
      mutate(clu = str_remove_all(clu, " "),
             imm_name = na_if(as.character(imm_name), ""),
             pi_vac_week_v1 = round(vac_week_v1 * (2*pi/52), digits = 11)) %>%
      group_by(clu) %>%
      mutate(checkgaps_all = replace_na(checkgaps, TRUE),
             checkgaps_all = all(checkgaps_all))
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod")
})
```

# Simulate 1 
```{r}
mod_name <- "bmv1_s08_hav_csi_reg_6.rds"
# Retrieve the data 
dat <- dat_l[[str_extract(mod_name, str_c(names(dat_l), collapse = "|"))]]
# Retrieve the model 
mod <- readRDS(glue(
  "{dirs$outputs}/models/{str_extract(mod_name, str_c(names(dat_l), collapse = '|'))}/{mod_name}"))
# Define cluster according to model name
clu <- str_extract(mod_name, "reg_6|reg_4|reg_3|reg_2")

# Create new data frame ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
nd <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    across(where(is.numeric)   & !any_of(c("pi_vac_week_v1", clu)), ~ 0),
    across(where(is.Date)      & !any_of(c("pi_vac_week_v1", clu)), ~ 0), 
    across(where(is.character) & !any_of(c("pi_vac_week_v1", clu)), ~ NA), 
    across(where(is.factor)    & !any_of(c("pi_vac_week_v1", clu)), ~ NA),
    across(where(is.factor)    & any_of(clu), ~ as.factor(as.character(.x)))
  ) 

# Simulate -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sim <- posterior_predict(mod, newdata = nd, re_formula = NA, summary = FALSE, ndraws = 10)
```

# Plot simulation 
```{r}
simtest <- as.data.frame(t(sim)) %>%
  mutate(clu_name = str_replace(nd[[clu]]," ", ""),
         pi_vac_week_v1 = nd$pi_vac_week_v1,
         type = "simulation") %>%
  pivot_longer(V1:V10, values_to = "imm_val_s1", names_to = "sim") %>%
  bind_rows(mutate(dat, type = "data", sim = "data") %>%
              rename(clu_name = clu)) %>%
  filter(sim %in% c("data", "V1")) 

simtest %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pi_vac_week_v1, y = imm_val_s1, group = clu_name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log") + 
  facet_wrap(type+clu_name~., scales = "free_y", ncol = 2)

simtest %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = imm_val_s1)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
    scale_x_continuous(trans = "log") +
  facet_wrap(type+clu_name~., scales = "free_y", ncol = 2)

```
